Ryōtarō Okiayu (Japanese: 置鮎 龍太郎 Okiayu Ryōtarō) is a Japanese voice actor for and .

==Biography==
Okiayu was born on November 17, 1969 in , , and became an actor as an adult. He originally voiced a character-of-the-day in before returning to the franchise in over two decades later in New Pokémon Snap and later .
